name: rocut
description: Drive the rocut agent-first video editor through its CLI: start a local backend host, show its authenticated editor URL in the workspace Web Pane, edit tracks/clips/assets/markers through revision-checked transaction batches via --target routing, verify structurally by re-reading, and rely on the project directory as the single source of truth. Requires a local rocut checkout with bun (S07 dogfood stage: no bundled build yet).
